comparator.sourceNotes: Exact Dutch full-time ordinary BA Religion, Politics and Society, specialisation of Religiewetenschappen CROHO50902 at Radboud. Registry1016O6659/1016O6837 and OER1015O6480/1015O9561 differ administratively; no code equivalence asserted. Degree identity is established by institution/title/CROHO/language/180EC. Adopted2026–27 annual framework and2025+ exit terms:120required+30restricted complete modules+30genuineopen=180EC,60peryear. One care module inB2 and one climate module inB3 selected independently ofUCRfit. Six5ECmodule components explicitly represented; alternative modules not additive. No shortened/IPS-Arabic/parttime/master conflation or future entrant timetable promise. RADArNL0required; equivalent university language-test exemption possible. Workgroup/practicum attendance80percent. Normalfulltime BSA44EC, late/reentry/deferred norms60EC in incorporated AppendixIII, which retains the current2026–27 document footer. PPO2 B2 builds onB1/PPO1 methods, yearlong research with individualpaper in collectiveproject. PPO3 B3 disciplinary knowledge, professional profile/portfolio/scientificfieldproject. Finalwork B3/AcademicSkills, compulsoryworkshop, approvedquestion and individualmethodologicalresearch under workshop/content supervision, complete by secondsemester; no replacement/exemption. Genuine open courses cannot overlap programme content or be masterlevel; external/nonfaculty electives and internship need applicable approval. Internship atmost15EC, nominalprogress, self-found placement and coordinator supervision/approval. OER care-code RTBA/RTIBA print variants do not establish a new course or extra credits; named component governs.

audience.programmeDescription: Students study religious traditions, texts and practices alongside social questions. They draw on anthropology, sociology and philosophy to investigate power, migration, media and cultural change.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR combination examines religious belief and practice through myth, religious art, material heritage, freedom of religion and the politics of identity. curriculum.routeLabel: Ordinary full-time bachelor; Religion and Care plus Worldviews, Nature and Climate modules
curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC framework includes 120 EC of required study, two complete 15 EC modules and 30 EC of free choice. Each selected module has three 5 EC courses. Research includes a supervised project and a 10 EC individual final work. RADAr-NL carries no credits; an equivalent university test can support exemption. The usual first-year study-advice threshold is 44 EC. External electives and internships need applicable approval; professional careers may require further qualifications.
